note.windows: Needs ski32.exe, free from its author at ski.ihoc.net (ski32sounds.exe, Alice Averlong's, adds the sounds); choose the folder it is in. The first build takes a few minutes. Python, CMake and the Visual Studio Build Tools (about 3 GB) are installed if they are missing; Windows asks for permission once.
note.darwin: Needs ski32.exe, free from its author at ski.ihoc.net (ski32sounds.exe, Alice Averlong's, adds the sounds); choose the folder it is in. The build takes a minute or two. It needs Homebrew and Xcode's command line tools, and installs SDL2 with Homebrew.
note.default: Needs ski32.exe, free from its author at ski.ihoc.net (ski32sounds.exe, Alice Averlong's, adds the sounds); choose the folder it is in. The build takes a minute or two. It needs a C/C++ compiler, CMake, Python 3 and SDL2 and SDL2_ttf from your package manager; if any are missing it says which, with the command to install them.
